g.text: post /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/judge/backtest Preview draft judge grading on one recorded iteration
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/decision-summary Get a run's decision summary
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/compare Compare a run against a baseline
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/iterations/{iterationId}/steps Get an iteration's step results
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun Rerun a run's failed cases
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/revisions List a suite's settings history
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/stage-analytics List a suite's per-run stage analytics
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/stage-analytics Get one run's stage analytics
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/gate Get one run's suite quality-gate report
post /projects/{projectId}/servers Save a server into a project
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/environments Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites List a project's eval suites
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/from-file Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId} Get one eval suite's configuration
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/run-disclosure Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/cases List a suite's eval cases
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/cases/generate Generate eval cases from the suite's tools
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/cases/import Author eval cases from a document
get /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/authoring/{jobId} Read an eval authoring job
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites/{suiteId}/authoring/{jobId}/commit Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/insights Request insights for an eval run
post /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/judge Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/claude Start a Claude directory-readiness run
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/openai Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/muse Start a Muse connector readiness run
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/conformance-runs Start a persisted conformance run
get /projects/{projectId}/registry/servers List curated and org registry cards
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/widgets/render Render an MCP App widget headlessly
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/widget-sessions Create a retained widget session
get /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/widget-sessions/{id}/snapshot Read a retained widget snapshot
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/widget-sessions/{id}/action Act on a retained widget
post /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/widget-sessions/{id}/scripted-step Run a retained widget step
